title: Tianji Disturbance
next_chapter_hook: A dimensional rift tears open, revealing scenery that does not belong to the Three Realms. That gaze seems to pierce through the endless Void, fixating directly upon him—the terrifying observation of the Heavenly Eye has finally descended.

text.content:
Deep within the Imperial Mausoleum, at the end of a dark corridor, Chen Ji sits cross-legged on a broken altar. Runic formations layer upon each other around him, faint Spiritual Light casting mottled shadows on the stone walls.

He has been in secluded cultivation here for seven days.

The Tianji Record Fragment floats beside him, golden characters flickering in and out of visibility, seemingly resonating with some kind of power. Chen Ji closes his eyes in meditation, guiding the Spiritual Energy within his body to flow slowly—this was his daily required practice, yet today, everything felt somewhat different.

At first, there was an extremely faint fluctuation, coming from the deepest part of the Imperial Mausoleum.

That fluctuation did not belong to Spiritual Energy, nor to demonic energy, but to something more primitive and terrifying. Chen Ji's Brow Center twitched—this was the perception ability granted to him by the Tianji Record. Whenever danger approached, he could always sense it earlier than others.

But this time was different.

This time, what he sensed was not a specific enemy, not an ambush, not a lethal technique. Instead... it was a force beyond comprehension, approaching in some manner.

dialogue.content:
"...Ji, wake up!"

An elderly and ethereal voice suddenly echoed in his mind. Chen Ji abruptly opened his eyes to see the Tianji Record Fragment floating beside him vibrating violently, golden characters flickering madly as if terrified.

"Mo Xiansheng?" Chen Ji's heart tightened, "What has happened?"

The remnant soul guardian's voice carried a rare gravity: "Something... is approaching. Faster and more terrifying than I anticipated."

text.content:
Space began to distort.

Chen Ji witnessed the Void before him forming unbelievable creases, as if an invisible giant hand was kneading this space. The rune formations on the stone walls suddenly blazed with blinding light, clearly sensing the intruder's presence.

The seal.

The reason this Imperial Mausoleum was jointly sealed by the three major Sects was precisely because something from the ancient era was imprisoned deep within. But Chen Ji never imagined the seal would malfunction here, at this moment.

The Tianji Record's vibrations grew increasingly violent.

Chen Ji reached out to touch the Fragment, and an unprecedented stream of information flooded into his mind—it was not text, but a fear that struck directly at his soul. The Tianji Record was warning him, in its unique way, telling him: what is coming does not belong to this world.

Not the Demonic Path.

Not ancient fierce beasts.

But... an existence that transcends the dimensional boundaries of the Three Realms.

Chen Ji's heart contracted violently. Heavenly Fate—he clearly sensed his Heavenly Fate Value within his body being consumed at a bizarre speed, as if something was forcibly抽取 his fate.

"Crack—"

A crisp sound was especially clear in the silent depths of the Imperial Mausoleum.

Chen Ji turned sharply, only to see a tiny crack on the stone wall directly behind the altar slowly expanding. A faint light leaked from the crack, that light was neither golden, white, nor any color he had ever seen, but a... chaotic hue that made one's scalp tingle upon one glance.

The seal... has broken.

And within that crack, Chen Ji vaguely glimpsed some indescribable existence writhing. It had no form, no face, yet gave a strong feeling of being watched.

Fear.

This was the purest fear Chen Ji had felt since beginning his cultivation.

Not the oppressive feeling when facing Han Lie, not the crisis feeling when facing Ling Yuan, but a trembling from the depths of life instinct. That was the uncontrollable survival instinct of a lower lifeform facing a superior being.

His legs grew slightly weak, cold sweat appearing on his forehead. If it were anyone else, they would probably have turned and fled by now.

But Chen Ji did not.

He stared fixedly at that crack, teeth clenched, forcing himself to stay alert. The Tianji Record's perception told him: that thing has not yet fully descended. It is in the crevice between two dimensions, searching for a breakthrough point.

dialogue.content:
"Don't look at it!"

Mo Xiansheng's voice rang out again, rarely carrying a hint of urgency, "That is not an existence you can直视! Your Tianji Record's aura has already been sensed by it—it is looking for you!"

Chen Ji hastily pulled back his gaze, yet discovered he could no longer move. That gaze from the crack seemed to have already penetrated his soul, locking him firmly in place.

"Mo Xiansheng," he lowered his voice, "what exactly is that thing?"

The remnant soul was silent for a moment before slowly uttering two words:

text.content:
Heavenly Eye.

Chen Ji's pupils contracted sharply.

This name, he had seen fragments of it in the Tianji Record. It was an existence beyond the Three Realms, a terrifying consciousness that treated all prophets as chess pieces. It never manifested in the mortal world, yet controlled everyone's destiny.

And now, it seemed to have noticed him.

"Impossible..." Chen Ji murmured, "I'm merely a small Tianji Record holder, why would it notice me?"

Mo Xiansheng's voice carried infinite vicissitudes: "Because you shine too brightly, child. Every insight you've gained with the Tianji Record is like lighting a bright lantern in the darkness. And that light... it has seen."

text.content:
Chen Ji took a deep breath, a fierce glint flashing in his eyes. He did not retreat; instead, he proactively activated all of the Tianji Record's perceptual abilities. In an instant, countless images exploded in his mind—past, present, future, the Three Thousand Great Dao weaving before his eyes into a magnificent scroll.

"I see it..." his voice carried a tremor, "its weakness..."

choices.description: Maintain calm, do not easily expose yourself, see what that thing actually wants to do
choices.visible_cost: May miss the best timing to respond
choices.visible_reward: Preserve Heavenly Fate Value, retain trump cards

text.content:
Chen Ji forcibly suppressed the fear in his heart, converging all his aura to the extreme. He closed his eyes, integrating himself into the darkness, becoming like a lifeless boulder.

That gaze from the crack lingered on him for a moment, seemingly judging his threat level. After a brief while, that gaze shifted away.

But Chen Ji knew, it had not given up. It was merely... probing.

choices.visible_cost: Exposing one's position, allies may fall into danger
choices.visible_reward: Gaining ally support, enhancing ability to cope

text.content:
Chen Ji acted decisively, injecting a strand of spiritual sense into the communication jade slip he carried. The message was brief and urgent: 'Imperial tomb seal is fluctuating, come quickly.'

However, the jade slip had barely been activated when it was crushed into dust by an invisible force. The existence from the rift let out a soundless mockery.

It... was preventing him from seeking help.

The rift is expanding.

The gap, once only the width of a finger, has now spread to the size of a palm. Chaotic light seeps through, illuminating the surrounding stone walls in flickering patterns. Chen Ji senses his Heavenly Fate value draining at an alarming rate—ten points, twenty points, thirty points...

The Tianji Record is screaming warnings.

But what truly chills him more is that something within the rift seems to be taking shape. It has no fixed form, yet radiates a suffocating pressure. It is a force that transcends the laws of the Three Realms, an existence before which even immortals must bow.

Chen's fists clench tight, his fingernails digging deep into his palms. Blood seeps out, only to instantly evaporate in the chaotic light.

Suddenly, an ancient voice rang in Chen Ji's ear, but it did not come from Mo Xiansheng.

The voice defied description, as if echoing directly in the depths of his consciousness:

'Found you... successor of the... Tianji Record...'

Chen Ji froze completely.

That was the voice of the Eye of Heavenly Secrets. It... was speaking to him.

'Finally... waited for you... I've waited... very long... very long...'

Each word struck Chen Ji's mind like a heavy hammer. He felt as if an invisible mountain was pressing down on him, making breathing difficult.

'Don't be afraid... I won't... hurt you...'

The voice continued, carrying a诡异gentle的语气，

'I just want... to see you... see how far my... chess piece... has grown...'

dialogue.content:
'Don't listen to it!'

Mo Xiansheng's voice erupted suddenly, carrying a desperate ruthlessness, 'It's interfering with your spirit! This is its specialty—generation after generation of seers have been eroded bit by bit by it!'

Chen Ji snapped awake, biting through his tongue to stay alert through the intense pain.

'Senior,' his voice hoarse, 'what should I do?'

Mo Xiansheng was silent for a moment before saying slowly: 'You have two choices—first, leave immediately, don't look back, don't resist, flee the imperial tomb at your maximum speed. That thing cannot fully descend for now, as long as you escape its perception range, you can preserve your life.'

'What about the second one?'

choice.prompt: Mo Xiansheng's words left Chen Ji at a crossroads. The pressure from the Eye of Heavenly Secrets grew stronger, and the rift continued to expand—

choices.description: Since it has already noticed me, running is pointless. Better to take the initiative and see what lies beneath this seal

text.content:
Chen Ji made his decision. He did not retreat; instead, he took a step toward the rift.

'Brat! Are you mad!' Mo Xiansheng cried out.

But Chen Ji could no longer hear. The Tianji Record in his hand vibrated intensely, as if transmitting some kind of message—the thing behind the rift has some unspeakable connection to the origin of the Tianji Record.

He had to see it with his own eyes.

choices.description: Preserve what you have to fight another day. First ensure your own safety, then plan for the future

text.content:
Chen Ji made the most rational choice. He suppressed his curiosity and turned to leave.

However, he had only taken one step when he felt an invisible force freeze him in place.

'Since you've come... why... rush to leave...'

The voice from the Eye of Heavenly Secrets rang out again, carrying a hint of amusement,

'My... little chess piece...'

choices.description: The Tianji Record is one of the Eye of Heavenly Secrets' chess pieces, perhaps it can also become a weapon against it
choices.visible_cost: The Tianji Record may expose all secrets
choices.risk_hint: Bet that the Tianji Record has a restraining effect on the Eyes of Heavenly Dao

text.content:
Chen Ji hurled the Tianji Record Fragment toward the rift with all his strength.

Golden light blazed intensely. The Tianji Record trembled violently within the chaotic-colored radiance. Two completely different forces collided in the void, producing an earth-shattering roar.

And in that moment, Chen Ji saw a vision—

It was an eye.

Countless eyes.

They filled the entire void, each one larger and more ancient than anything he had ever seen. They all gazed at him simultaneously, with a scrutinizing gaze, as if evaluating the value of merchandise.

"Not bad..." the voice rang out again, "More promising than I anticipated..."

Chen Ji felt a pressure unlike anything he had ever experienced.

The gaze of the Eyes of Heavenly Dao was no longer mere observation—it had become tangible, pressing ruthlessly against his divine soul. He felt as though an invisible mountain was crushing him, making even breathing a struggle.

"I... merely... wish to observe..."

The voice continued, each word like thunder, 

"To see... how far my chess piece... has grown..."

Chen Ji's teeth clenched tightly. He wanted to say something, wanted to resist, but his body refused to obey. Before this existence beyond the Three Realms, everything he had prided himself on seemed so utterly ridiculous.

He was the inheritor of the Tianji Record, the strategist who left nothing to chance, thetrash disciple who devoured tigers. But now, before the Eyes of Heavenly Dao, he was nothing but an ant.

The rift was expanding.

What had been a palm-sized crack had now spread to the size of a washbasin. The chaotic-colored light grew brighter and brighter, almost threatening to devour the entire Imperial Mausoleum. Chen Ji felt his Heavenly Fate Value depleting at a terrifying rate—fifty points, sixty points, seventy points...

At this pace, it wouldn't be long before he was completely drained.

"The Tianji Record..." the voice carried a hint of amusement, "is a gift I left for this world... and you... are merely the user I chose..."

Chen Ji's heart lurched.

The Tianji Record... was created by the Eyes of Heavenly Dao?

Did that mean all the abilities he had prided himself on all these years were nothing more than pieces on someone else's board?

Chen Ji felt a deep chill rise from his spine.

If the Tianji Record was truly a creation of the Eyes of Heavenly Dao, then all his arrangements, all his calculations, all his feigning weakness to devour tigers over the years... weren't they mere child's play in the eyes of such an existence?

But just as despair was about to overwhelm him, the Tianji Record suddenly erupted with blinding golden light.

That golden light was entirely different from the chaotic-colored radiance—it carried a pure, righteous, inviolable aura. Within that golden light, Chen Ji glimpsed a figure—the true master of the Tianji Record, Chen Xuan.

"Descendant..." an aged yet gentle voice sounded in his ear, "Fear not... you are not alone..."

Chen Ji's eyes reddened slightly.

Chen Xuan—the legendary ancestor, the true master of the Tianji Record—had actually reached out to help him at this moment.

"Senior..."

"There is no time to explain," Chen Xuan's voice carried urgency, "That thing cannot fully descend for now, but you must make a choice—continue staying here to oppose it, or take this chance to escape?"

Chen Ji took a deep breath, forcing himself to calm down. His gaze swept across the expanding rift, then looked at the Tianji Record suspended in the air.

This was a huge gamble.

If he fled now, perhaps he could preserve his life. But if he stayed... perhaps he could discover the key to changing everything.

text.content:
Chen Ji did not hesitate. He reached out and grabbed the Tianji Record Fragment.

In an instant, golden light blazed brilliantly! Chen Xuan's remnant soul merged with the Tianji Record, transforming into a radiant light that surged toward the rift. The two forces collided in the void, producing a thunderous roar that shook heaven and earth.

Chen Ji saw that the countless eyes reaching out from the rift were actually closing, one by one, within the golden light.

"Despicable..." the voice from the Eyes of Heavenly Dao carried anger for the first time, "Chen Xuan... again... ruining my plans..."

text.content:
Chen Ji gritted his teeth and turned to run.

Behind him, Chen Xuan's remnant soul transformed into a streak of golden light, slamming fiercely into the rift. Golden light and chaotic-colored radiance collided intensely, causing the entire Imperial Mausoleum to tremble violently.

"Go!" Chen Xuan's voice rang out, filled with determination, "Remember, find the complete version of the Tianji Record! That is the key to defeating it!"

Chen Ji ran with all his might, not daring to look back. He felt the energy fluctuations behind him growing increasingly intense, and what seemed like the Heavenly Dao's Eye's roar reached his ears.

But he did not dare look back.

Because he knew, as long as he was alive, there would still be hope.

Chen Ji burst out of the Imperial Mausoleum with all his strength.

When he finally saw the sky outside, his entire body was almost completely drained. His Heavenly Fate Value had decreased by nearly a hundred points, and the Tianji Record's light had dimmed considerably. But he was still alive.

A muffled roar echoed from the depths of the Imperial Mausoleum, as if the seal had temporarily stabilized. Chen Xuan's remnant soul had blocked the first wave of the Eyes of Heavenly Dao's assault, buying Chen Ji precious time to escape.

Chen Ji fell to his knees, gasping for breath. Cold sweat had already soaked through his clothes, but he had no time to worry about that. His mind kept reverberating with that voice—

"My... chess piece..."

The Eyes of Heavenly Dao. It had finally noticed him.

And this... was only the beginning.

The dimensional rift tore open a corner, revealing a landscape that did not belong to the Three Realms.

Chen Ji would never forget that scene—within that chaotic-colored light were countless eyes. They filled the entire void, each one larger, more ancient, and more terrifying than anything he had ever seen.

Those eyes gazed at him simultaneously, with scrutiny, amusement, and an indescribable emotion.

That was the Eyes of Heavenly Dao.

The terrifying existence that viewed him as a chess piece.

The ultimate antagonist transcending the dimensional boundaries of the Three Realms.

Chen Ji knelt on the ground, his body trembling uncontrollably. But in his eyes, an unprecedented fire was burning.

"I will remember you..." he whispered, his voice hoarse yet resolute, "Someday, I will pull you down from that lofty throne."

That day... would not be far away.
